cc:Work.dc:title: f01_obligations
cc:Work.dc:description: The upper matrix compares native, tiled and packed projection arithmetic on RTX. Native q8, q16 and q32 each have 16 unequal complete outputs among 16 pairs; tiled and packed fours match, and packed q2/q4 are marked not run. The lower B570 tracks locate 99 mismatches at indices 29 through 127 on one of three inputs in each of two speculative arms. Counts total 198 of 1,920 vectors before physical-view repair and zero afterward.
